title: Add a picture
subtitle: Media sit beside the deck and are named by a path
bullets: Pictures and videos are not kept in git: a deck's media folder is copied to and from an asset store
A slide names a media file by a path that starts at the media folder
task: Copy any picture into `@public` (make the folders) and call it `picture.png`. Then add the line below to this slide's file, right after the line that starts with `"layout"`.
ask: In the tutorial deck, add a picture to the slide task-picture: make a simple PNG, put it where that slide's media go, and name it in the slide.
whenDone: In a project, `npm run assets -- push` would now copy that picture to the asset store.
